purpose: Traceable legal-philosophy study and judgment support; educational only, not individualized legal advice.
five_why: Users need more than summaries: they need to know why a claim is justified.
Justification fails when source text, scholarship, law, case and model inference are mixed.
Mixed layers hide conflicts, stale authority and interpretation choices.
Without explicit evidence and falsification, polished prose can look more certain than its basis.
Therefore the system must separate claim layers, bind outputs to current source receipts, preserve counterevidence and fail closed.
risk_boundaries: No claim may label scholarship as primary text or legal authority.
No source update success without current HTTPS retrieval, validation and payload hash.
No fabricated quotation, section, case, citation or authority.
Contradictory sources remain visible; the engine may not silently average them.
Missing primary-source lineage keeps the corresponding business gate NOT VERIFIED.
